claim_verdicts.evidence: Docs (latest; the /3.5/ path returns 404): "Alerting rules are configured in Prometheus in the same way as recording rules." "The alert counts as active for these elements' label sets". prometheus.yaml L53 at stage-4: `evaluation_interval: 15s`; slo.rules.yml L12-41: both alerts sit in group slo-s3-product-reads after its four `record` rules.

Docs: "The optional `for` clause causes Prometheus to wait for a certain duration between first encountering a new expression [output vector element and counting an alert as firing]"; "Elements that are active, but not firing yet, are in the pending state."; "Alerting rules without the `keep_firing_for` clause will deactivate on the first evaluation where the condition is not met". A re-appearing element is a new one, so `for` restarts. Rule has no keep_firing_for.

Docs: comparison operators "By default they filter"; "`vector1 and vector2` results in a vector consisting of the elements of `vector1`" for which vector2 has elements with exactly matching label sets. Execution: the steady-10% case (expects ProductReadsFastBurn firing with {job: api}) passes in outputs/stage-4/scripts/devops/alert-rules-test.txt ("SUCCESS"), so `and` pairs the two differently named recorded series on job.

Docs: "The `labels` clause allows specifying a set of additional labels to be attached to the alert." "The `annotations` clause specifies a set of informational labels". The page assigns no semantics to any label value such as `severity`; alerts.md L63-64 gives page/ticket their meaning.

alerts.md L63-65: "Mức `page` gọi người trực ngay (`on-call.md`); mức `ticket` thành việc trong backlog, xử lý trong giờ làm việc. Mỗi alert `page` có runbook; annotation `runbook` của rule ghi đường dẫn file đó."

Docs: alerting rules "are not a fully-fledged notification solution"; "In Prometheus's ecosystem, the Alertmanager takes on this role." alerts.md L83-85: "Prometheus giữ trạng thái của alert (pending, firing) nhưng không gửi thông báo cho ai. Staging chưa chạy thành phần gửi thông báo". Grep -i alertmanager over examples/don-hang: no match.

slo.rules.yml L25-41 at stage-4: ProductReadsFastBurn expr `ratio_rate1h > (13.44 * 0.005) and ratio_rate5m > (13.44 * 0.005)`, `for: 2m`, `severity: page`, summary + runbook; ProductReadsSlowBurn `ratio_rate6h > (5.6 * 0.005) and ratio_rate30m > (5.6 * 0.005)`, `for: 15m`, `severity: ticket`, summary only. 13.44 × 0.005 = 0.0672; 5.6 × 0.005 = 0.028.

Round 2: s5 now reads "the same pair of alerting rules for S1, S2 and S4 ... each with its own SLI's allowed share, eight alerting rules in all" (round-1 suggested_text). slo.rules.yml at stage-4: 8 `alert:` (L25,35,55,63,83,91,111,119), 16 `record:`; S2/S4 use `* 0.01`. Captured output "SUCCESS: 24 rules found".

The Site Reliability Workbook is not a `docs` root in content/versions.yaml, so it is not an admissible source for this review; no root listed there documents the multi-window, multi-burn-rate method or its parameter table. Not fetched. Kind `history`, recorded as such by DECISIONS 2026-10-22 (5); non-blocking.
